googleHint: When you finish, choose YOUR personal Google account. From now on you sign in only with it, using the "Sign in with Google" button. The old login (e-mail and password) stops working.

leader.title: Update your leader profile
leader.desc: The unit login is being replaced by the leader's personal login. Fill in your details and connect your Google account to continue.

mentor.title: Update your mentor profile
mentor.desc: Access is now personal, through your Google account. Check your details and connect your Google account to continue.

blocked.hasLeaderTitle: This login is no longer used
blocked.hasLeaderDesc: The unit {{unit}} already has a registered leader ({{name}}), who signs in with their Google account. If you are the new leader, talk to your mentor.
blocked.noUnitDesc: This login is not linked to any active unit. Talk to your mentor.

errors.name: Enter your full name.
errors.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the Google window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
errors.googleInUse: This Google account is already in use in the system. Choose another Google account or talk to your mentor.
errors.notEnabled: Google sign-in is not enabled yet. Contact support.
errors.save: Could not finish. Please try again.

notice.title: Your access is now personal
notice.desc: You signed in with the old login. Updating takes 1 minute.
notice.change1: You will sign in with your Google account.
notice.change2: The old login and password stop working.
notice.change3: The team keeps your correct name and WhatsApp.

role.desc: Choose the option that fits you.

unit.question: Who is using the login of unit {{unit}}?
unit.segueDesc: This login becomes your personal leader login.
unit.professorDesc: Personal access for teachers is coming soon.
unit.saiu: I'm no longer at this unit
unit.saiuDesc: You do not continue with this login.

leader.question: Are you still the leader of unit {{unit}}?
leader.segueDesc: Your details are updated and you carry on as usual.
leader.professorDesc: Your mentor changes your access to teacher.
leader.saiu: I no longer work at this unit
leader.saiuDesc: You do not continue with this login.

mentor.question: Are you still a mentor?
mentor.segueDesc: Your details are updated and you carry on as usual.
mentor.saiuDesc: You do not continue with this login.

stop.professor: Do not continue with this login. Tell the unit leader or your mentor: they will adjust your access. Personal access for teachers is coming soon.

data.title: Check your details
data.desc: We filled in what the system has. Fix anything that is wrong.
data.unitNameHint: This used to show the unit's name. Now it is your name.
data.moreUnitsLabel: Do you lead another unit too? (optional)
data.moreUnitsHint: Each unit you pick becomes a request: its mentor approves it. Your mentor can also add you later.

google.title: Connect your Google account
google.desc: It will be your login from now on.
google.warning: After this step, the login {{login}} and the old password stop working.
google.hint: Choose YOUR Google account, personal or work. Do not use a unit account that other people also use.

done.title: Profile updated
done.desc: From now on, sign in with the "Sign in with Google" button.
done.extraRequested: Your requests for the other units were sent. When each unit's mentor approves, they will show up for you.
done.mentorChecks: Your mentor will confirm that you are the leader of unit {{unit}}.

exit.leaderWarn: When you confirm, your access is turned off right away. The unit is left without a leader and your mentor is notified. If this was a mistake, they can undo it.
exit.manyUnits: You leave every unit you lead: {{units}}.
exit.professorQ: You are also a teacher. What do you prefer?
exit.keepProfessor: Leave leadership and keep going as a teacher
exit.keepProfessorDesc: You stop being a leader, but you can still sign in to see your classes.
exit.leaveAllDesc: You lose all access to the system.
exit.mentorWarn: When you confirm, your mentor access is turned off right away and the Group Classes Manager (administrator) is notified. They will reassign your units. If this was a mistake, they can undo it.
exit.error: Could not record the exit. Try again.
exit.doneBlocked: Your access has been turned off. Thank you for your work!
exit.doneProfessor: You left leadership and continue as a teacher.
